name: China Railway Special Cargo Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: China Railway Special Cargo Logistics Co., Ltd. provides special cargo logistics services in China. It offers automotive and cold chain logistic services; and logistics equipment and trains. The company also engages in railway transportation, technical services, and equipment management of long and large cargo, including designing cargo loading and reinforcement plans, and transportation plans; provision of railway transportation technical consultation; and cargo agency transportation. China Railway Special Cargo Logistics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Beijing, China.
